body:
Los Angeles County Employees Retirement Association (LACERA) has issued a €200m commitment to a value-add fund managed by infrastructure manager CVC DIF, according to a board meeting document.

Cheryl Lu, principal investment officer in LACERA’s real assets investment division, told IPE Real Assets that CVC DIF Value-Add Fund IV is expected to invest primarily in Europe, with a smaller allocation to assets in North America.

Lu added: “We believe the fund complements LACERA’s non-core infrastructure portfolio, providing exposure to lower mid-market infrastructure opportunities supported by a well-resourced team with an established relationship with LACERA.”

Fund IV has a €2bn fundraising target and seeks investments capable of delivering net internal rates of return of at least 13% across sectors including digital, energy transition and sustainable transportation.
